name: Min Max Quantity – Minimum/Maximum Quantity, Step Control & Price Limit for WooCommerce
author: StorePlugin

sections.description:
Min Max Quantity for WooCommerce gives you full control over how products are purchased in your store. You can define minimum and maximum quantity rules, enforce step quantities (multiples of X), and even set cart and order-level restrictions.

Whether you want to restrict sales on specific products, categories, or the entire store, this plugin ensures customers order within your desired rules—improving inventory management and preventing order issues.

✨ Quick links:
👉 Features & Details
👉 Support
👉 Upgrade to Pro

Key Features

Our free version comes packed with all the essential tools you need to control product purchase rules in your WooCommerce store.

  • Minimum & Maximum Quantity Control
    Define the minimum and maximum number of units a customer can purchase for any product. Prevent customers from ordering too few or too many items, helping you balance sales and inventory.

  • Step Quantity (Buy in Multiples of X)
    Allow customers to buy products only in specific multiples. For example, customers can order in 2s, 5s, 10s, etc. This is perfect for wholesale stores, bulk orders, or products sold in fixed packs.

  • Per Product Rules
    Apply quantity rules to individual products. Want one product to have a minimum order of 5 and another with a maximum of 2? You can set rules on a product-by-product basis.

  • Global Store-Wide Rules
    Set default min/max and step rules that apply across your entire store. Save time by applying consistent restrictions without editing each product manually.

  • Cart-Level Restrictions
    Control the total number of items customers can add to their cart. For example, you can require a cart to contain at least 3 items or limit it to a maximum of 50 items.

  • Order-Level Restrictions
    Set limits based on the total order. For instance, require a minimum of $50 before checkout or restrict the maximum order quantity. This ensures your orders remain profitable and manageable.

Premium Features

Upgrade to Pro for advanced quantity management features that give you even more flexibility.

  • Variation-Level Rules
    Apply min/max and step rules to individual product variations. Ideal for stores selling products with size, color, or style variations where each variation has unique order requirements.

  • Category-Level Rules
    Set quantity restrictions for entire product categories. For example, you can limit “Wholesale” products to a minimum of 10 units per item while leaving other categories unrestricted.

  • Tag-Based Rules
    Apply restrictions using product tags. Great for grouping specific products (e.g., “Sale” items or “Limited Edition”) and controlling their purchase quantities without affecting other products.

  • Customizable Error & Alert Messages
    Show clear and friendly messages when customers try to break your rules. You can fully customize the wording to match your store’s tone and guide buyers toward the correct purchase.

  • Advanced Rule Combinations
    Mix and match product-level, variation-level, category-level, and tag-based restrictions for highly tailored order control. Perfect for stores with complex product requirements.

👉 Get MinMax Quantities Pro

Enhance your store with our other plugins

  • Variations as Single Product for WooCommerce – Show variations as single product on shop, product category and search result page.
  • Advanced Custom Order Status for WooCommerce – Create, edit, delete or add new custom order statuses and trigger the custom emails when order status changes
  • Product Search for WooCommerce – Search products by SKU, title, category, attributes, tags, and custom taxonomies.
  • WooCommerce Product Table Builder – Create product table with Drag-and-Drop Table Builder, filter, sorting, pagination and more.
sections.installation:
The Plugin installation process in WordPress is very easy and convenient. Simply follow the steps below to get started.

  1. Upload minmax-quantities-for-woocommerce plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Set the quantity restriction from WooCommerce -> Min Max Quantity
